title: Decoding a Boolean symbol
statement: For every optional Boolean symbol $v$, let the blank test return true exactly when $v$ is absent, and let the one test return true exactly when $v$ is the symbol true. The optional symbol reconstructed as absent when the blank test is true, and otherwise as the result of the one test, equals $v$.
hypotheses_covered: v is an optional Boolean symbol
